training.selection: minimum val soft cross entropy; earliest epoch on tie

teacher.mode: current-memory budgeted BFS using table accepted OCR
teacher.success: both values confirmed and equal to offline truth
teacher.ties: equal probability soft targets, either shortest direction counts correct
teacher.wrong_ocr: retain actual memory; simulate conflict repair; wrong complete memory STOPs and is excluded from direction training
teacher.unsolvable: retain in excluded log; no direction invented
teacher.dedup: same scene, quantized causal feature vector and teacher target collapsed; all source refs retained
teacher.reliability_gate: 100 percent accepted value/ambiguity agreement on train/val visits; pixel invariance not assumed

live_evaluation.starts: one existing sampled start per scene; common start and seed across methods
